$comment: Desired Cloudflare state for the public website edge. Applied by scripts/cloudflare/edge_policy.py. ${HOSTNAME} is the proxied hostname; ${PUBLIC_WWW_EDGE_VERIFY_SECRET} is read from the environment at apply time and never stored here. Plan: docs/plans/cloudflare-edge-protection.md.

rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path eq "/v1/activities/search" and not (any(http.request.uri.args["limit"][*] eq "1") or any(http.request.uri.args["limit"][*] eq "12") or any(http.request.uri.args["limit"][*] eq "24") or any(http.request.uri.args["limit"][*] eq "30")))

(http.request.uri.path eq "/v1/activities/search" and (http.user_agent eq "" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "python" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "curl/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "wget/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "go-http-client" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "scrapy" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "httpx" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "aiohttp" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "java/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "okhttp" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "node-fetch" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "axios/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "headlesschrome" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "phantomjs" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "puppeteer" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "playwright" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "selenium"))
